thread:
Ava: Drafting an "autorescue" UX idea. Goal: provide safe automated fallbacks during rollouts without surprising customers or creating noisy oscillation. High level modes: monitor-only, sampled-rescue, sticky-rescue. Would like quick feedback on telemetry + audit expectations.

Rohit: Sounds good. Need clear definitions: sampled-rescue = reroute X% of traffic for verification; sticky-rescue = flip routing until manual revert or health recovery.

Jules: UX priorities: show dry_run status, a confidence meter for why the policy fired, and a small cost delta preview before enabling enforcement. Teams should be able to "peek" at what would have happened.

Ava: Proto-like sketch (YAML style for readability):

```
policy_id: autorescue-exp1
mode: sampled-rescue
sample_rate: 0.02
triggers:
  - http_5xx_rate>0.03
  - p95_latency_ms>450
  - eval_regression>0.10
hysteresis_s: 120
escalate_after_windows: 3
fallback_target: open-quant-lite
prefer_dedicated: false
dry_run: true
audit: timeline,decision_path,sampled_input_hash
```

Tess: Add a 'min_hold_s' so sticky doesn't flip back too quickly. Also we should include 'suppress_during_incident' flag so SRE can turn off automation globally.

Rohit: Telemetry: emit tags rescue.policy_id, rescue.mode, rescue.trigger_snapshot, rescue.decision, rescue.sample_rate, rescue.estimate_cost_delta. Audit lines must include reason_code and a short decision_path (e.g., "5xx>threshold -> sample -> escalate-window:2").

CI-Bot: deploy:policy-engine/PR-701 -> staging passed :white_check_mark: https://ci.internal/701

Jules: Console: per-policy row shows last 24h decisions sparkline, current dry_run badge, last_trigger (with top 2 signals), and a tiny "simulate" button that asks for a date range. Simulate should return: affected_ratio, estimated_cost_delta, and example sanitized samples.

Ava: On sampling: we should exponentially increase sample_rate on repeated trigger windows rather than immediate full reroute. E.g., 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% after N windows. Helps avoid thrash.

Tess: Audit storage: store only hashed sample pointer in policy engine. Sidecar uploads sanitized sample batches to secure blobstore and returns sample_url_hash. Audit line contains sample_url_hash and retention metadata. Must have PII redaction step.

Rohit: Also need operator metadata when an override happens: operator_id, override_reason, override_type (soft/force). Include that in audit for compliance.

Jules: For the "Why?" modal: top 3 contributing signals, timeline view with sampled vs enforced dots, a cost delta badge and a small reproducible replay button that launches the simulate flow. Keep it compact so PMs and SREs can skim.

Ava: Edgecases: dedicated pools. If prefer_dedicated=true and fallback_target isn't available in the dedicated pool, policy should escalate to operator with a reason_code rather than silently using hosted fallback. Also tie into quota windows: if quota_utilization>threshold, policy may avoid fallback or only sample.

Tess: For canary adoption: default new policies to dry_run:true for 7 days and require an explicit enable button. Console should show "dry_run until <date>" and allow manual enable with confirmation flow that surfaces historical simulation numbers.

CI-Bot: policy-engine:ingest-audit -> eventstream ok :white_check_mark:

Rohit: Implementation notes: policy engine emits audit events to eventstream with a decision_id. Sidecar processes sample requests keyed by decision_id and returns sample_url_hash upstream. Telemetry pipeline needs to index rescue.policy_id, decision_outcome, and estimate_cost_delta for aggregate dashboards.

Jules: Can we add an "operator_appeal" action in the console where an operator can flag a decision as wrong and attach notes? That would feed into future ML-based heuristics for better triggers. Include operator_id and note in audit.

Ava: Love the appeal idea. We should persist appeal state in policy metadata and include it in the timeline. Also add a "snooze" option to suppress automation for a short window.

Tess: Security ask: retention defaults to 90 days for samples; allow enterprise customers to lengthen or shorten via settings. All sample uploads must be encrypted at rest and access-controlled.

Rohit: Action items: (1) Ava: open proto PR with sample_rate ramping + precedence and prefer_dedicated handling, (2) Jules: console mocks for policy row + "Why?" modal + simulate flow, (3) Tess: sample storage + redaction + retention doc, (4) Rohit: telemetry schema and eventstream fields.

Ava: I'll include migration for existing policies and default dry_run:true. Will link PR once ready. Thanks all!
